collect._comment: Audits the SPA root (`/`) only — every Nuxt route serves the same client shell, so a single audit is representative. Mobile preset (default) matches PRD §6's '3G mobile' target. 3 runs; lhci takes the median.

settings._chromeFlagsComment: Forgejo's act_runner executes the workflow as root inside the container, and Chrome refuses to run as root without --no-sandbox (crbug.com/638180). --disable-dev-shm-usage avoids /dev/shm exhaustion in containers with small tmpfs sizes.

assert._comment: Locks today's measurements with ~10% headroom. LCP ceiling (3500 ms) is intentionally LOOSER than PRD §6's 2500 ms target — the current shell measures ~3.2 s on the mobile preset, so the PRD target is an aspiration and the gate's job is to prevent regressions while we close that gap. Tighten LCP toward 2500 once the LCP-improvement work lands.
